what: A dark, easy groovebox for acid lines, chopped breaks and warped funk. RITUAL turns two of 15 styles into a full 4-track song with one button, always in key. LIVE adds mutes, stutter, build and drop; NEXT suggests three continuations of your phrase. Tape echo and an eye that feels the music.
author: Polaris Sound Lab
sounds: CC0: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition and VCSL samples (piano, flute, sax, kept from Felucca); the FM voice bank and sounds/DarkFunkDurcal_DX7.syx are own
